thread:
Maya Chen: Quick heads-up — I'm pulling together the leadership readout for ACME Corp's upcoming quarterly check-in. Need final slide deck, top 3 risks, and a one-slide renewal ask. Planning to run a dry-run Thu 10am PT. Can folks confirm availability?

Liam O'Neill: Available Thu 10am. Onboarding status: prod infra ingest at 85%, two items blocking (S3 policy + schema test).

Arjun Patel: Noted. Renewal risk: ACME budget review 2 weeks after QBR. Let's flag any escalations now. I'll draft the renewal slide with current ARR and usage delta.

Nadia Ruiz: I'll own enablement — will pull top customer questions and a 5-min demo clip. Putting the enablement checklist in the deck.

Sara Thompson: Feedback capture: sent a short survey to primary contacts yesterday; 6 responses so far. I'll summarize in one bullet.

Maya Chen: Thanks. Action items:
- @Liam: unblock infra items + one-sentence status for slide.
- @Arjun: draft renewal slide + recommended ask.
- @Nadia: enablement bullets + demo clip link.
- @Sara: feedback bullets + NPS stat.
Please add to the live deck by Wed EOD.

Liam O'Neill: Will add infra slide. For the blockers: S3 policy change approved pending config (PR #482). Schema test failing on edge-case: tracked in Jira ACME-117.

Arjun Patel: Drafted renewal slide — proposed ask: 12-month commit with Dedicated credits, and we provide 3 months of onboarding assistance. Putting numbers in deck.

Nadia Ruiz: Demo clip uploaded: https://redwood.corp/drive/acme-demo.mp4. Added 2 FAQ bullets.

Sara Thompson: Survey summary: 6 responses, avg satisfaction 4.2/5, main ask: shorter integration docs. Putting one slide.

Maya Chen: Great. Quick sanity check on slide order: 1) Health metrics 2) Onboarding status 3) Product wins 4) Risks & asks 5) Next steps. Can someone run the Thu dry-run script? Prefer someone to act as 'ops lead' during run.

Liam O'Neill: I can run it. I'll be ops lead. Also will include runbook snippet: ```Runbook: if S3 error -> retry policy -> contact infra oncall```

align-bot: Reminder — Dry-run scheduled Thu 10:00 AM PT. Calendar invite sent to Maya, Arjun, Liam, Nadia, Sara.

Maya Chen: Thanks all. Last ask: if you add slides, please include a 1-line speaker note so I can narrate. I'll consolidate Wednesday evening and send final to execs.

Arjun Patel: Done — renewal slide + speaker note added.

Nadia Ruiz: FAQ and demo speaker notes added.

Sara Thompson: Survey slide + speaker note added.

Liam O'Neill: Infra slide + runbook added. See deck link: https://redwood.corp/slides/acme-q2-readout (last updated 2101112240).

Maya Chen: Perfect. Last_message: confirming dry-run Thu 10am PT. Thanks team :raised_hands:
